profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ JPMorganChase  | Front-End Engineer
profile.summary: A Software Engineer with experience building and designing UX interfaces and analyzing datasets seeking an opportunity to spark joy in users.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed a phased migration plan and Architecture Decision Record (ADR) to enhance the design library and technical stack.  
• Designed and implemented reusable React components for notifications, ensuring consistency across user workflows.  
• Integrated analytics SDKs to track feature adoption, supporting informed product decisions.  
• Built interactive usage statistics dashboards to aid the product team in prioritizing roadmap features.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Collaborated with stakeholders to develop data-driven UI workflows using React and Ag-Grid for managing +100 complex entity mappings.  
• Resolved UI bugs and implemented automated end-to-end QA testing to enhance front-end reliability and user experience.  
• Contributed to the migration of an Angular application to AWS EKS, modernizing deployment and improving scalability.  
• Led a social committee for a cohort of over 60 members, showcasing strong organizational and communication skills.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.locationName: Prairie View, Texas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Conducted Name Entity Recognition (NER) tasks using a BERT model on the Conll 2003 dataset.  
• Generated word embeddings to enhance a generic NER model's performance.  
• Compared the efficacy of BERT-based methods against a baseline model utilizing GloVE embeddings.  
• Developed strong analytical and programming skills in natural language processing and machine learning.

positions.title: DEVELOP Intern
positions.description: Utilized NASA earth observations to assess the accuracy of the Omnibus Q-Test change detection algorithm in identifying mining-related deforestation in the Madre de Dios region of Peru.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Pandas · Google Earth Engine

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Collaborated with a non-profit to identify core personnel management challenges.  
• Developed a wireframe prototype to address identified needs effectively.  
• Integrated user interface components for a web application, enhancing operational efficiency.  
• Contributed to saving the organization approximately 40 hours monthly through streamlined processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Figma (Software) · Git · React.js · JavaScript · Jira

positions.title: Tech Exchange Scholar
positions.description:
• Selected as one of 40 scholars nationwide for Google’s prestigious Tech Exchange program.  
• Completed advanced coursework in Human-Computer Interaction, Product Management, Tech Entrepreneurship, and Software Development.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Constructed the user interface for a tool that reduced the time to generate test data by 90% using React.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Compared common methods of ML feature selection to the deep neural pursuit (DNP) method

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description: Automated the visualization of permission-based security matrix reducing errors and update time by 40%

projects.title: Force for Good
projects.description: Developed and implemented a solution to improve a non-profit's catalog ordering process, addressing issues with design, data entry errors, and overall workload. Utilized FormAssembly's Salesforce Connector and referenced the Salesforce Entity Relationship diagram from the non-profit to integrate form field logic that ensured accurate and consistent data capture, eliminating manual data entry and reducing the potential for errors, resulting in a more efficient and user-friendly ordering experience.

organizations.position: Business Technical Diversity Chair · Nov 2018 - May 2019
